gantt.title: Project timeline
gantt.intro: A task list with a timeline that colours itself. Type a start date, an end date and how much is done, and the bars, status and totals update. No macros, works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS.
guide: Open the Plan sheet. Type each task, who does it, the start date and the end date in the yellow boxes.
Type how much of each task is done as a percentage, for example 50%. Done turns green, late tasks turn red and today is marked in yellow.
Pick Days or Weeks above the timeline to zoom out for long projects. Change the timeline start date to scroll through time.
Open the Owners sheet to see how many tasks each person has, how many are done and how many are late. Add more people in the yellow list.
guideHi: Plan sheet kholein. Peele boxes mein har task, kaun karega, start date aur end date likhein.
Har task kitna ho chuka hai percentage mein likhein, jaise 50%. Pura hone par green, late hone par red aur aaj ki date peeli dikhti hai.
Lambe project ke liye timeline ke upar Days ya Weeks chunein. Timeline start date badal kar aage peeche dekhein.
Owners sheet mein dekhein kis ke paas kitne task hain, kitne ho gaye aur kitne late hain. Peeli list mein naye log jodein.
gantt.aboutPlan: The task list and the timeline bars.
gantt.aboutOwners: Tasks, done and late for each person, with a chart.
gantt.subtitle: Type in the yellow boxes. Bars: green is done, light orange is still to do, red is late, yellow column is today.
gantt.unitHelp: Days for short projects, Weeks for long ones.
gantt.ownerHelp: Pick a name from the Owners sheet, or type a new one.
gantt.ownersSub: Type the names of the people in the yellow list. The numbers come from the Plan sheet.

attendance.title: Attendance Register
attendance.intro: One sheet for each month with the days, weekends and holidays filled in for you. Pick a code for each day and the totals and attendance percentage update. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings. Type your organisation name, choose your weekly off days and list the holidays. These shade themselves on every month.
Open the first month. Type each person's name once. The names appear on every other month and on the Summary automatically.
For each day pick a code from the drop-down: P present, A absent, L leave, HD half day. Weekends and holidays are already grey.
The columns on the right add up days worked, absent, leave and the attendance percentage. The Summary sheet shows all months together.
guideHi: Settings kholein. Organisation ka naam likhein, hafte ki chhutti chunein aur holidays likhein. Ye har mahine mein apne aap grey ho jate hain.
Pehla mahina kholein. Har vyakti ka naam ek hi baar likhein. Baaki mahino aur Summary mein naam apne aap aa jate hain.
Har din ke liye drop-down se code chunein: P present, A absent, L leave, HD aadha din. Weekend aur holiday pehle se grey hain.
Daayein taraf ke columns din, absent, leave aur attendance percentage jodte hain. Summary sheet mein saare mahine ek saath dikhte hain.
attendance.aboutSettings: Organisation name, weekly off days, holidays and the attendance codes.
attendance.aboutMonth: One sheet for each month. Pick a code for every person and day.

attendance.weekOffHelp: Yes means a normal day off, which is greyed on every month.
attendance.alertHelp: Percentages under this turn red. Choose the limit your own rules use.
attendance.cellHelp: Pick P, A, L or HD. Leave blank for a day off.
attendance.cellError: Please pick one of the codes from the Settings sheet.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.intro: A printable invoice that fills in prices and addresses from your own lists. You choose up to three taxes and their rates. A log keeps track of what is paid and what is late. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open the Items sheet and list what you sell with its price. Open the Customers sheet and list your customers with their addresses.
On the Invoice sheet type your business details. Pick a customer, then pick an item on each line and type the quantity. The price fills itself, and you can type over it.
Name your taxes and type the rates yourself, for example VAT 20%. Leave a tax blank if you do not charge it. Check your own rules: the rates are only what you type.
Print the Invoice sheet, or save it as a PDF. Then add one line to the Invoice Log so you can see who has paid and who is late.
guideHi: Items sheet kholein aur jo bechte hain uska daam likhein. Customers sheet mein apne customers aur unke pate likhein.
Invoice sheet par apni business details likhein. Customer chunein, har line mein item chunein aur quantity likhein. Daam apne aap aata hai, aap badal bhi sakte hain.
Apne taxes ka naam aur rate khud likhein, jaise GST 5%. Jo tax nahi lagta use khali chhodein. Rate sirf wahi hain jo aap likhte hain, apne niyam khud check karein.
Invoice sheet print karein ya PDF mein save karein. Phir Invoice Log mein ek line jodein taaki dikhe kis ne paise diye aur kaun late hai.
invoice.aboutItems: Your price list. Items and prices appear on the invoice.
invoice.aboutLog: Every invoice, what was paid and what is late.
invoice.itemsSub: Type what you sell and its price. These show up in the drop-down on the invoice.

invoice.roundHelp: Yes rounds the total to a whole number.
invoice.itemHelp: Pick an item. The rate fills in from the Items sheet. You can also type a new one.
invoice.customerHelp: Pick a customer from the Customers sheet, or type a name.
invoice.discountHelp: Optional. Type 10% for ten percent off this line.

billing.title: Monthly Delivery Bill
billing.intro: For milk, tiffin, newspapers, water cans and any other regular delivery. Each customer starts with their usual quantity filled in for every day, so you only change the days that were different. The bill, the balance and a message to send are worked out for you. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your business name, what you deliver and the unit. Open Customers and list each customer with a phone number, the price per unit and the usual quantity per day.
Open the Entry sheet. Every day is already filled with the usual quantity. Change only the days that were different. A different day turns orange, and 0 turns red.
Type what each customer paid in the Paid column. The balance and status (Paid, Part paid, Pending) update. Opening balance carries what was owed last month.
Use the Bills sheet to print one customer's bill. Use Reminders to open WhatsApp with a message ready for each customer who still owes money. Summary shows the totals and charts.
guideHi: Settings kholein aur apne business ka naam, kya deliver karte hain aur unit likhein. Customers mein har customer ka phone, ek unit ka daam aur roz ki aam quantity likhein.
Entry sheet kholein. Har din mein aam quantity pehle se bhari hai. Sirf wo din badlein jo alag the. Alag din orange aur 0 red dikhta hai.
Paid column mein likhein har customer ne kitna diya. Balance aur status (Paid, Part paid, Pending) apne aap badalte hain. Opening balance pichhle mahine ka baaki hai.
Bills sheet se ek customer ka bill print karein. Reminders se jis par paisa baaki hai uske liye WhatsApp message khulta hai. Summary mein total aur chart dikhte hain.
